zh-CN.title: 科研工作区焕新
items: 科研首页直接浏览并筛选课题，概览集中展示任务进度与课题组
阶段任务采用清晰的列表与详情布局，进度和回复统一使用 Markdown 编辑器
日程与会议记录分开展示，优化手机横竖屏及深色模式排版

en.title: A clearer research workspace
items: Browse and filter projects directly, with task progress and team information in a new overview
Read tasks in a focused list and detail layout, with shared Markdown editors for progress and replies
Separate calendars from meeting records, with improved portrait, landscape and dark-mode layouts
